intro: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Principal final selection result under Advertisement 02/2026 on 20 November 2026.
As per the published cut off table, the cut off is 243.00 marks for both male and female candidates. Candidates can download the final merit list from the official website.
steps: Go to the Results / Notices section.
Open the Principal Advt 02/2026 final result PDF.
Search your roll number using Ctrl+F.
Download the cut off table for your category.
